svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A clean 114 L open-head drum, 463 mm across, 737 mm tall, with its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bolt-ring lid. Same rules for past contents and paint as the outer drum.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gas holes: eight 20 mm holes in the base on a 300 mm circle, 45

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: degrees apart, one on the line of the probe slot. Step drill.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Probe slot: 10 wide x 40 tall in the side, centred 300 mm above

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the base (the middle of the 600 mm fill). Drill and file.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Handles: two M8 U-bolts, legs 80 mm apart, through four 9 mm holes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in the lid, 130 mm each side of centre; nuts and large washers

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: under the lid. Mark the slot's position on the lid rim.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: stands on the three bricks; the base holes stay clear of them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the lid seals on its gasket when the ring is bolted.
